title: Leading coefficient of a complemented falling factorial
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, let $Q_{n,k}(X)=\prod_{i=0}^{k-1}(n-X-i)$. The leading coefficient of $Q_{n,k}(X)/k!$ is $(-1)^k/k!$.
